title: Transparent AI-driven personalized risk prediction system for acute kidney injury after total hip arthroplasty.
summary: CatBoost with feature selection and SMOTEENN predicted KDIGO-defined acute kidney injury after total hip arthroplasty, with 97 events among 4,601 patients, internal AUC 0.95 and external AUC 0.65 in 240 patients. The independent hospital test is valuable, but the drop to 0.65 shows limited transportability, so this is a preliminary risk-prediction model rather than a clinically ready one.
